ChenSantAnnaXie2025 and AkbariKiyavashGhassami2025 give efficient/cross-fitted estimators in their respective DiD and canonical-DDD models, not learned joint shared-comparison DDD covariance.

novelty_flags.label: lem:pairwise-identification
novelty_flags.one_line: The pairwise clean-comparison identification and weighted-combination conclusion are already covered by Ortiz-Villavicencio and Sant'Anna's Theorem 4.1 and Corollary 4.1; retain it only as a supporting reduction.

soundness_flags.label: estimand_functional
soundness_flags.one_line: The displayed observed-law functional contains an unbound comparison index c, so it does not define a scalar functional; bind c or display the declared average over the admissible comparison set.

soundness_flags.label: thm:efficient-eif-bound and varphi_omega^star
soundness_flags.one_line: The candidate canonical gradient is only described verbally: neither the population projection operator, its Hilbert space/domain, nor the target derivative being projected is defined, so the claimed score and V_eff are not yet determined objects.

soundness_flags.label: ass:sieve-empirical-remainders and def:attainment-class
soundness_flags.one_line: The attainment class is defined by rates of named off-fold nuisance, covariance, Gram, adjoint, projection, and ridge procedures rather than primitive properties of P; specify those procedures and put their performance conditions in the theorem, or restate the class through law-level estimability conditions.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 15-16, Theorem 4.1 and Corollary 4.1; p. 19, Remark 4.6
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.1 identifies each clean-comparison staggered-DDD ATT; Corollary 4.1 identifies every weights-sum-to-one combination; Remark 4.6 gives optimal GMM based on recentered influence functions.
The paper derives conditional-covariance-weighted EIFs for staggered DiD/event-study parameters and an estimator attaining its efficiency bound.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 8-9, Theorem 5, equation (6), and cross-fitted estimator construction
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper derives a nonparametric panel-DDD EIF for its canonical two-period design and constructs a cross-fitted estimator from it.
The paper computes semiparametric efficiency bounds for sequential moment restrictions containing unknown functions and presents an optimally weighted orthogonalized sieve minimum-distance estimator.

source_verification_receipts.locator: article record; arXiv:1608.00060v7, abstract and cross-fitting description
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The cited paper is the 2018 Econometrics Journal DML paper and supplies K-fold cross-fitting for orthogonal-score estimation.
The paper presents stacked DDD as complementary to GMM, explicitly describing a transparency/pairwise-assumption trade-off against efficiency and shared-control dependence.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the unbound-c observed-law functional with a fully indexed comparison average, and state the population tangent space, projection operator, and resulting canonical-gradient formula before asking for a closed-form simplification.

Make the estimator genuinely executable: define the nuisance/covariance/conditional-mean learners and deterministic tuning/solution rules, then move estimator-rate conditions out of the law class into theorem hypotheses stated in law-level norms.

Promote the fixed-GMM result from a componentwise GLS identity to an aggregate joint-covariance comparison against both the Ortiz-Villavicencio--Sant'Anna constant-GMM estimator and the Chen--Sant'Anna--Xie conditional-weighting construction.

recommended_next_step: Continue revision on this angle: repair the functional and projection definitions, then replace the procedure-dependent attainment class with a fully specified estimator and primitive theorem conditions.
